_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no vol spike, flat funding, and still-soft ETF/momentum leave score drifting into the adjacent Complacency band rather than breaking directionally.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD toward Complacency; narrative has no forward phase call (flow snapshot only), so no conflict but no confirmation
next_move.confirmed_if: Score holds 47-54 with continued drift, soft ETF flows, muted 30d momentum, and no VIX/funding shock
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows and momentum reclaim together (up into Disbelief) or funding turns negative with VIX spike and accelerating downside (back into Anxiety/Panic)
